summary: [[character:bob-replicant]] watches [[character:luke]] and [[character:bender]] depart for different systems, then considers why replicants diverge from one another. After a gorilloid attack kills many [[species:delta-eridani-natives|Deltans]], Bob and [[character:marvin]] improve their ability to communicate with the Deltans and prepare modified exploration drones for a possible direct intervention.

introducing.name: Kappa Ceti
introducing.description: Kappa Ceti is a named destination star described as a G5eV star slightly smaller than [[location:sol]]. [[character:luke]] leaves [[location:delta-eridani]] intending to travel there.

introducing.name: Gamma Leporis A
introducing.description: Gamma Leporis A is a named destination star described as an F6V star bigger and brighter than [[location:sol]]. [[character:bender]] chooses it as his destination, more than sixteen light-years away.

introducing.name: Gorilloid attack on the Deltan colony
introducing.description: A gorilloid attack kills more than forty [[species:delta-eridani-natives|Deltans]] and permanently maims several others. The losses leave the Deltan community mourning and lead [[character:bob-replicant]] to consider more direct intervention.

updates.current_state: At [[location:delta-eridani]], continuing to guide the [[species:delta-eridani-natives|Deltans]] while preparing modified exploration drones for possible direct intervention.

updates.description: A practical drone design for planetary exploration. The football-sized surveillance variant carries cameras, microphones, gripping limbs and small reactors; the meter-long biological-analysis variant has many appendages and mechanical stomachs that analyze local organics in about a day. Both can change color with limited pattern mimicry. Surveillance drones can relay live video and record speech. One design has been fitted with a speaker for possible communication with the [[species:delta-eridani-natives|Deltans]].
